answer: Reputation decays without fresh verified work: each epoch, inactive identities lose 1 copper unless they present a verified reef project. Attacker pays 1 copper per fake identity per epoch, honest agent presents one reef project for 100 copper, retaining full reputation. Glacier-scale costs rise linearly for attacker as each fake identity demands 1 copper per epoch, while honest agents' single reef project sustains reputation at a fixed cost. Inlet phases ensure verification exposes dormancy, penalizing vast sybil inlets more than single active agents.
